def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    full_employment_gdp = 1_300  # billions of dollars
    actual_gdp = 1_200  # billions of dollars
    mpc = 0.8

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    gdp_gap = full_employment_gdp - actual_gdp
    fiscal_multiplier = 1 / (1 - mpc)
    required_increase_in_government_expenditures = gdp_gap / fiscal_multiplier

    # return answer
    return required_increase_in_government_expenditures
